nodes.label: stock.png dark trading terminal UI screenshot
nodes.description: Full-window screenshot of a dark navy Bloomberg-style trading terminal layout with cyan, green and amber accents. Text glyphs render as placeholder boxes, so labels are not readable.

nodes.label: Multi-panel terminal dashboard layout
nodes.description: Dense multi-panel layout: top nav bar, KPI strip, left sidebar, search panel, main data table panel, watchlist panel, and bottom status bar.

nodes.label: Top navigation bar with mode buttons
nodes.description: Thin header strip with a logo-like block at left, a search input, and a row of pill buttons. One pill is filled bright green as the active state; others use colored outlines (amber, cyan).

nodes.label: KPI summary strip with four stat blocks
nodes.description: Row of four labeled metric blocks under the header, each with a small caption above large cyan or amber value glyphs. Suggests market KPI tiles.

nodes.label: Left sidebar navigation list
nodes.description: Vertical list of nav items with the active item highlighted by a solid dark-cyan bar with a left accent line. Lower entry has a circular cyan icon.

nodes.label: Search and filter panel
nodes.description: Floating card with a magnifier icon, a label, and a light text input field for querying a ticker or symbol.

nodes.label: Main stock data table with scrollbar
nodes.description: Large right-hand panel holding a scrollable table with about ten rows, a checkbox-style first column, white numeric columns and green-tinted value columns on alternating dark row stripes.

nodes.label: Bottom-left light table panel
nodes.description: Small dark card with a light-background list of rows and a tall empty area below, likely a watchlist or picks list.

nodes.label: Bottom status bar
nodes.description: Full-width dark bottom bar with an amber left marker and two text runs separated by a divider, likely status and clock or feed info.

nodes.label: Dark navy and neon accent color system
nodes.description: Design language: near-black navy panels, cyan outlines and headings, bright green for active and positive values, amber for secondary highlights. Matches the Nova Terminal theme direction (design tokens and QSS).

nodes.label: Nova Terminal unified UI
nodes.description: Likely the Nova Terminal (terminal/main_window.py with terminal/pages) screen, inferred from the Bloomberg-style layout and the file name. Labels are not readable, so this is an inference.
